skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the financial appraisal process and its role in project investment decisions.
Identify and measure project investment risks.
Prepare financial analysis and appraisal reports for specific investment projects.
Work independently or in groups to analyze and appraise specific investment projects.
Apply financial criteria and risk analysis to make investment decisions.
Use Excel for financial calculations and project analysis.
Create financial models to assess investment projects.
Evaluate investment projects using NPV, IRR, and other financial metrics.
Conduct sensitivity analysis, scenario analysis, and Monte Carlo simulations to assess project risks.
Analyze and interpret financial data to make informed investment decisions.
